dedupe_keys.name: variacion multitemporal de la isla de calor entre 2023 y 2024

description: Variación multitemporal de la isla de calor entre 2023 y 2024 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servpubpre.madrid.es. Analytical map of changes in the heat island effect between 2023 and 2024, prepared according to the following methodology: 1. Obtaining the ICU (Urban Heat Island) for each year with the influence of the same four representative months of each season: March (winter), May (spring), July (summer) and October (autumn). 2. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Multitemporal variation of heat island between 2023 and 2024" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Geoportal Madrid, temperatura, medio ambiente, isla de calor, clima, calor. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
